text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: The final race of the Classic Triple Crown—the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I didn't think I would get the chance to run in it when you removed it from my timetable.
choice_data_list: I'm glad our adjustments paid off.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: That said, I must focus on working toward my new goal now.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I won't fixate on the fact that it's a Triple Crown race nor will I consider it different from any other race. This time, I only have one goal…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: And that is to get good results, as always. That is all.
